parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBProxyConnectStringNetType
parameters.description:
The network type of the database proxy endpoint. Valid values:

*   **Public**
*   **VPC** (default)

>  If the RDS instance runs MySQL, this parameter is required.

parameters.name: DBProxyEndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the database proxy endpoint. You can call the DescribeDBProxyEndpoint operation to query the ID of the database proxy endpoint.

parameters.name: DBProxyEngineType
parameters.description: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: DBProxyNewConnectString
parameters.description:
The prefix of the new database proxy endpoint. A custom value is supported.

>  You must specify at least one of the **DBProxyNewConnectString** and **DBProxyNewConnectStringPort** parameters.

parameters.name: DBProxyNewConnectStringPort
parameters.description:
The port number that is associated with the database proxy endpoint. A custom value is supported.

>  You must specify at least one of the **DBProxyNewConnectString** and **DBProxyNewConnectStringPort** parameters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy-endpoint-address --db-instance-id rm-t4n3a0000 --db-proxy-endpoint-id ta9um40000 --db-proxy-new-connect-string test123456 --db-proxy-new-connect-string-port 3307 --db-proxy-connect-string-net-type Public --db-proxy-engine-type normal --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ModifyDBProxyEndpointAddress --region cn-hangzhou --DBProxyEndpointId ta9um40000 --DBInstanceId 'rm-t4n3a0000' --DBProxyNewConnectStringPort 3307 --DBProxyNewConnectString test123456 --DBProxyConnectStringNetType Public --DBProxyEngineType normal
